title: Two parallel screen-to-physics-ray pickers with hard-coded layer masks
evidence: input_router.gd:88 `var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from, from + dir * 200.0, 0b11)` / connect_controller.gd:130 `var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from, from + dir * 200.0, 0b01)`
detail: InputRouter._pick and ConnectController._project_pointer duplicate the same ray construction with divergent masks (0b11+areas vs 0b01). Physics-layer knowledge is spread across two input modules; a layer change must be edited in sync in both.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared pick helper (mask as a parameter) used by both, so the camera-ray boilerplate and layer scheme live in a single place.

title: Pure-math Geodesic class coupled to scene-tree Node3D in snap_candidate
detail: Geodesic is documented as 'pure static math, side-effect free', yet snap_candidate takes scene nodes, type-filters Node3D, and reads global_position — the math layer now depends on the scene graph. Its docstring even claims candidates carry a `pos`.
recommended_fix: Have snap_candidate accept positions (PackedVector3Array) and return an index, or move the node-selection wrapper into ConnectController and keep Geodesic position-only.

title: WorldSeed is a grab-bag: RNG spine + layout + placement + palette tokens + radius
detail: The 'owned-RNG spine' module also hosts the entire look palette, so HUD (hud.gd:12), NodeSite, PipeArc and Planet all import the world-gen module purely for color tokens. E2+ token growth will deepen this coupling.
recommended_fix: Split palette/radius tokens into their own constants class (e.g. Palette) so visual modules stop depending on the world-generation module.

title: Test-only helpers shipped in production scripts; gameplay uses a different projection path than tests pin
evidence: geodesic.gd:81 `static func ray_sphere(...)` / orbit_camera.gd:90-96 `## Test/inspection helper: the camera's world-space up vector.\nfunc camera_up()`
detail: ray_sphere, camera_up() and ideal_up() have no production callers (only tests/ reference them). Worse, tests pin ray_sphere math while the verb projects via physics intersect_ray — the tested projection is not the shipped one.
recommended_fix: Either use Geodesic.ray_sphere for the actual pointer projection (single tested path) or drop it; move camera_up/ideal_up assertions into the test file.

title: Identical closest-to-0.65-arc site-pair search in capture harness and gesture test
evidence: capture_runner.gd:110 `func _readable_pair(sites: Array) -> Array:` (hard-coded 0.65) / test_gesture.gd:131 `func _pair_with_arc(sites: Array, target: float) -> Array:`
detail: Two copies of the same O(n^2) arc-pair search, one in a prod script and one in tests, both hunting a ~0.65 rad readable pair. Any tuning of the readable span must change both.
recommended_fix: Promote the pair search to one shared static helper (e.g. on Geodesic or a test/capture utility) parameterized by target arc.

title: ConnectController fuses gesture state machine with the pipe pair-registry (the future connection graph)
evidence:
## pair key -> {count: int, arc: PipeArc}
var _registry := {}
detail: The input-verb controller also owns the unordered pair-key registry with counts and merged-bundle rebuilds — the incipient topology graph E2's flow sim must consume. Sim data fused to an input controller invites cross-layer reach-in later.
recommended_fix: Extract a small PipeRegistry (pair key, count, arc) that ConnectController delegates to, so E2 reads topology without touching the input layer.

title: Stringly-typed Dictionary contracts at every module boundary
evidence: static func wedge_layout(seed_value: int) -> Dictionary: ... return {"order": colors, "spans": spans, "starts": starts, "gaps": gaps} / node_site.gd:17 `func setup(info: Dictionary) -> void:\n\tsite_name = info.name`
detail: wedge_layout, node placement info, and the registry entry all cross module boundaries as untyped Dictionaries with comment-only key contracts; a renamed key fails at runtime, not parse time. Systemic pattern across the slice.
recommended_fix: Introduce small RefCounted data classes (WedgeLayout, NodePlacement) with typed fields for the inter-module contracts.
